title: Profile provider interface addresses
description: profile-relay-runtimes (generic part, docs/development/profile-relay-runtimes.md). Every Profile item and every profile preset carries providerInterfaces: one row per provider interface with its address and whether that address is the provider's official one (cutex decides; clients never compare hosts). Official addresses are only defaults: a relay keeps the provider's runtime options. Additive: present on every host with this contract, whether or not the capability flag profile-relay-runtimes is advertised; the flag says that every ACP runtime of the host (DSH, Kimi Code) sends requests to a relay address too. Without the flag, relay addresses for interfaces with relayAccepted false are refused. Hosts advertising the flag accept relay addresses for every address-bearing interface; a launch whose interface has no address answers variant_base_url_missing.

interfaceKind.description: openaiCompatible (cute-codex; address = providerBaseUrl) | anthropicCompatible (Claude API account; address = the account's baseUrl) | deepseekNative (DSH: DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible root, default https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic; address = interfaceBaseUrls) | kimiNative (Kimi Code: same address as openaiCompatible) | chatgptLogin | claudeSubscription | kimiAccount (logins: no address). Open set.

baseUrl.description: The address new agents use. null: a login (no address), or required but missing (deepseekNative while the main address is a relay and no DSH address is set: launches refuse with variant_base_url_missing; never guessed).

baseUrlDefault.description: The provider's official address for this interface (the official region of baseUrl when it is official). null: none (custom, Gemini relays, logins).

official.description: baseUrl is one of the provider's official addresses for this interface. true for logins; false for relays and missing addresses.

relayAccepted.description: This host's runtime for the interface uses a non-official address. false for logins, and for deepseekNative / kimiNative until the host advertises profile-relay-runtimes (writes of a relay address answer 400 relay_runtime_unavailable).

presetFields.description: GET /v2/profile-presets items: a new profile of the preset on its default address (deepseek adds deepseekNative; moonshot / kimi-code add kimiNative).

interfaceBaseUrlsWrite.description: PATCH /v2/profiles/{p} and POST /v2/profiles (kind apiKey or dsh): interfaceBaseUrls merges into the profile's stored interface addresses; null restores the official default. Only interfaces whose address lives here (deepseekNative on DSH profiles and DeepSeek API-key profiles) are accepted. http(s) with a host, no credentials, query or fragment. Applies to runtimes started afterwards.
